builds.name: Reference: Mixed tank
builds.goal: Reference for Skarner: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A terrain-crossing frontline controller who delivers three empowered attacks and drags targets into walls or his team's damage. Measure three-hit attack sequence, terrain entry and target dragging. HP/AD damage only pays if control lands; do not count imaginary multi-target R connections. Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
builds.summary: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact.
testPlan: Kit question for Skarner: Measure three-hit attack sequence, terrain entry and target dragging. HP/AD damage only pays if control lands; do not count imaginary multi-target R connections.

Start with the early core (Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health, armor/MR and close-range effects test reliable frontline contact. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.

The route fails Skarner's stated kit question: Measure three-hit attack sequence, terrain entry and target dragging. HP/AD damage only pays if control lands; do not count imaginary multi-target R connections.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Heartsteel stacks must be finite; percent-health damage and kiting punish excessive health.
Full cost 15,700 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Matchup defense or Heartsteel only if stacking is safe. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Unending Despair, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing [150 / 250 / 350 + (1) × AP] magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for [1.5]s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability.

If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains [40]% Move Speed for [1.5] seconds.

If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.

Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge.

Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.06) × Stat(12)] physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for [1.1]s.

Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.

Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Speed and dealing [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional [11]% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by [40]% for [1]s.

Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing @spell.SkarnerQ:AbilityDamage@ + @spell.SkarnerQ:MaxHPPercent*100@% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowPercent*100@% for @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowDuration@s.

Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking for [4]s. At [3] stacks of Quaking, enemies take [(characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 9; raw flags preserved)) × (0.01)] max Health magic damage over its duration.

builds.name: Boulder bruiser delivery
builds.summary: Use three boulder attacks and a terrain pin to test health-to-AD investment.
builds.goal: Use three boulder attacks and a terrain pin to test health-to-AD investment.
builds.hypothesis: Q empowers three attacks with attack speed and physical scalings; the final attack has 11% target-max-health damage. Bloodmail converts bonus health to AD and Titanic rewards attacks. E wall collision has AD[statFormula=2] and health physical scaling; W shield uses Stat(12). Passive magic damage remains separate from Cleaver armor reduction.
testPlan: Required state: Complete the three attacks and E wall collision with finite health and observed AD.
Compare three-attack Q versus immediate throw, logging physical packets, passive magic and W shield.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Kiting forces early Q throw and removes attack-dependent item value.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Q Stat(12)[statFormula=2] is retained; do not silently substitute total health.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Titanic Hydra, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage, Spirit Visage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Suppression escort field
builds.summary: Explore AP plus nearby amplification around a multi-target R drag.
builds.goal: Explore AP plus nearby amplification around a multi-target R drag.
builds.hypothesis: R has 1 AP magic damage and can suppress three champions while granting move speed on a hit. W has 0.8 AP area magic damage plus a self shield. Cosmic can help reposition after magic contact and Abyssal amplifies nearby magic while Liandry tests follow-up damage; E supplies the initial pin.
testPlan: Required state: R hits at least one champion and the drag keeps targets near allied magic damage.
Record R victims, drag distance, aura proximity and W/passive damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The AP slots lower defenses, and a miss leaves no protected escort interval.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: R triggering an active Q throw does not prove each target gets three passive stacks.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
